version.changelog: Major update: Added true affordability calculator, systematic property evaluation, offer strategy building

llm.summary: This real estate skill is purpose-aligned and transparent about local storage, with no evidence of hidden network access, exfiltration, or destructive behavior.

dimensions.detail: The included scripts use local Python standard-library functionality and write only a property log under the declared OpenClaw real estate memory path; no network or credential access was found.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No install hooks, dependency installation, remote retrieval, tool wrapping, or startup modification were found in the inspected artifact files.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The activation text is broad for real estate topics, so users should expect it may be invoked during general home-buying, selling, mortgage, inspection, or rental conversations.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill discloses persistent local storage under memory/realestate, and evaluate_property.py writes property addresses and prices to properties.json; this is sensitive but scoped and purpose-aligned.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill provides affordability, property evaluation, offer, inspection, lease, and transaction support, which coherently matches its real estate purpose and includes clear professional-advice limits.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, understand that property details and financial inputs may be stored locally in the OpenClaw real estate memory area. Use it for educational support only, and rely on licensed real estate, mortgage, and legal professionals for transaction decisions.
llm.findings:
[LP3] expected: The local memory behavior is disclosed and limited to the real estate memory directory in the inspected script; the lack of an explicit permission declaration is a reviewability limitation, not evidence of overbroad or hidden behavior.
[SQP-1] expected: The activation language is broad, but it is still centered on real estate workflows and does not by itself trigger hidden collection, network transmission, or unrelated tool use.
